ratings_why.fun: Setting the river each turn and watching cascades is a good puzzle, but the early turns punish you for the headline mechanic and growth stays a slow, linear Stamp count until Tier 5.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because deaths pull the whole board up a step mid-fight, so slot order is a live in-fight resource and choosing who dies first and who goes home is unlike any tribe today.

verdict_why: Spawning is a net loss before Tier 4, so the always-right early play is to keep fish from coming home; one rules change to the Spawn payoff would fix the early curve.

points.text: Spawn is forced and early it costs a bought 5-7 stat unit for a 1/2 Alevin plus about +2/+2 of Gift, so blocking B1 is always right until Mother Redd. Make the early Spawn pay, for example a Gift of +1/+1 per Stamp plus the spent fish's tier, or let the Alevin keep all Stamps.
Tier 1 and 2 have no unit that makes coming home good on its own; a Tier 1 or 2 Spent card would give the Homecoming build a seed from the first turns.
Mother Redd sends Alevins to a 4-card hand; say what happens when the hand is full, since with the Warden she can make six a turn.
Spawning a golden turns it into an Alevin; a line saying goldens keep their body, or a clear warning in the UI, would stop the worst feel-bad.
Old Kelt is the tribe's best card with one gap and blank on a full board; a second mode for a full board (say, swap with the unit at the mouth) would keep him live late.

standouts.why: Old Kelt turns one empty slot into a Stamp for the whole run and a sure homecoming; the clearest expression of the river.
Warden of the Hazel Well turns a long cascade into many homecomings and a permanent buff each, a real direction card.
Old Bradán replays every Gift inside the fight with no lasting cost; a big, readable capstone payoff.

weakest.why: Alevin is a 1/2 that only grows by surviving fights; as the tribe's Tier 1 seed it wins no early fights.
Pebble-Carrying Hen still adds only a couple of stats per Spawn at Tier 4.
Sea Trout Ferrywife gives no stats and only matters with off-tribe units in the run.

flags.note: With the Warden and Little Jack Gravel, Mother Redd can make enough Alevins for a golden Alevin and a Discover most turns late.
A long cascade with the Warden gives +1/+1 to every unit per fish home, up to about +7/+7 a fight, then every one of them Spawns.
Doesn't say where the Alevin goes when the hand is full.
